description: Resolve a unit cost + flat setup cost for a quantity — a pure read (no quote is created). Three forms: (a) itemSku alone — prices via the item's DEFAULT sourcing profile: the profile names the book, and the spec is derived live from the item's current custom-field values; refused (naming the missing or unrecognized attributes) when the item's own data does not resolve the book's cost drivers. (b) bookId + spec — prices an explicit spec-keyed grid directly; also works for ComponentPriced books (the response includes a componentBreakdown with each component's contribution). Spec values are normalized against the book's schema first, so a numeric-band attribute accepts the raw number ('6') or its band label ('6-inch') interchangeably. (c) bookId + itemSku — prices an item against a book that prices by item rather than by spec, which has no sourcing profiles to go through. found=false in the result means nothing in that book priced it; for ComponentPriced books the result's unresolvedComponents then names each component that applies to the spec but had no matching rate — a component never silently drops out of the sum.

bookId.description: Explicit form: the price book id (GUID). Requires spec.

itemSku.description: Item form: an item SKU, priced via its default sourcing profile. Mutually exclusive with bookId/spec.

quantity.description: Quantity to price (must be greater than zero).

spec.description: Explicit form: concrete cost-driver attribute values keyed by the book's schema, e.g. {"trim": "6x9"}.
